problem_statement: Calling event_timeout_clear() on an event timeout that has not yet been initialized with event_timeout_ztimer_init() must not crash when the event timeout is backed by ztimer. It must be safe to clear such an uninitialized object and then later initialize and set it. Today, clearing an uninitialized ztimer-backed event timeout can crash.

verification.reason: The problem statement already specifies the exact public behavior tested: event_timeout_clear() must be safe on an uninitialized ztimer-backed event timeout, and subsequent event_timeout_ztimer_init()/event_timeout_set() must work. No hidden names, values, or implementation details are required.
